issues.detail: The Transactions widget chips and Tasks Incomplete/Completed chips behave like tabs but are exposed as role=menuitem buttons with no tablist or selected state. The avatar menu button and the four widget kebab buttons have no accessible name.
issues.evidence: Dashboard: 5 <button role="menuitem"> chips (Recent … Operating expenses), 0 [role=tablist]. Avatar <button aria-haspopup="menu" class="_menuButton_ko7ja_21"> with no aria-label, img alt="". Kebabs: 4× <button aria-haspopup="menu" class="… _menuButton_ok3n2_7"> with no aria-label or text.
issues.title: Filter chips, avatar and widget kebabs lack proper semantics

issues.detail: The same widget family mixes superscript cents, inline cents and abbreviated amounts. Accounts rows show '$200,000.00' with superscript cents, but the hover tooltip for that same row shows '$200,000.00' inline; the Disputes widget shows '$3,444.23' inline; the balance table's 'Pending transfers $71,764.10' is inline while its siblings are superscript; the Invoicing widget puts 'Overdue 4 · $950.00' (superscript) next to 'Paid 12 · $6K' and 'Open 12 items · $12.3K' (abbreviated). Search results and the payment review hero ('$1,042.95', 34px Arcadia Display) also drop the superscript used by the Home hero.
issues.evidence: Accounts row: span._superscript_1of3b_35 (15px parent, 10.95px sup, top -2.9px). Hero: 28px Arcadia Display, sup 20.44px. Pending transfers: 13px, fraction span has no _superscript class. Disputes '$3,444.23 at 3 merchants': plain 12px text node. Search '$1,952.15': 15px, fraction span with empty class. Payment review: span._titleHero_qaod7_12 34px/380 plain text '$1,042.95'.
issues.title: Cents shown three different ways on Home
